Context
-------
Read .github/copilot-instructions.md and check feedback/
airgap-run-*.md (none expected yet).

The transferable unit is the git repository. Nothing else. No custom
ZIPs, no payload archives, no sidecar files. This is a hard
constraint. Every provisioning script must either use files already
in the repository tree or fetch what it needs from Artifactory at
runtime.

Consequences:
- The k3s binary is fetched from a configurable Artifactory
  generic-file URL at provisioning time.
- The k3s airgap image tarball is dropped entirely — k3s pulls system
  images from Artifactory via /etc/rancher/k3s/registries.yaml.
- The container image tooling that produced separate fallback bundles
  in dist/ is retired from the workflow.
- The repository itself carries the small vendored files (workshop
  repos, docs mirrors, runtime-download archives, k3s install.sh,
  k3s-selinux RPM, app_pod.yaml, reveal.js-menu). These stay.
- MANUAL-FETCH.md becomes a runtime-recovery reference: how the
  operator handles a fetch failure on the VM, not what to stage
  before a transfer.

This task runs on the connected upstream machine only. Do not access
the learner VM or run provisioning against it.

Objective
---------
Align the repository with the repo-only transfer workflow. Retire the
packager. Drop the airgap tarball. Make every runtime fetch
recoverable on the VM without any second transfer.

Task 1 — set the k3s binary URL in lab-vm.conf
----------------------------------------------
Add:

  K3S_BINARY_URL=""
  # Set on the learner VM before running script 45.
  # Artifactory generic-file URL for the pinned k3s binary (v1.37.1+k3s1).
  # Obtain the exact URL from the Artifactory administrator.
  # The pinned SHA-256 lives in versions.lock; do not duplicate it here.

Leave it empty in the committed file — it is set on the VM, not in
source. 10-preflight fails with a clear fix-hint if script 45 would
be reached with K3S_BINARY_URL still unset.

Keep unchanged:
  WORKSHOP_USER="engineer"
  PASSWORDLESS_SUDO="yes"
  DOCS_PORT="8090"
  MANUAL_FETCH_DIR="/var/tmp/o11y-lab-vm-manual"
  DOCKER_REGISTRY="${ART_HOST}/artifactory/docker-registry"

Do not add Docker CE, Docker daemon, Compose, or /etc/docker config.

Task 2 — retire the packager
----------------------------
Read scripts/dev/package-vm-transfer.sh.

Remove it from the workflow. Two acceptable outcomes:

  (a) Delete the script and any adjacent packaging helpers.
  (b) Keep it but move it under scripts/dev/retired/ with a short
      header comment stating it is not part of the transfer workflow
      and is retained only for historical reference.

Prefer (a) unless the operator has a reason to keep it. Also delete
scripts/dev/make-image-bundles.sh unless the operator wants it
retained as a retired tool for the same reason.

Remove any commands in README-FIRST.md, MANUAL-FETCH.md, or the
consistency docs that invoke the packager.

The dist/ directory is gitignored. Do not delete its contents; leave
it as a local artifact.

Task 3 — update scripts/00-diagnose.sh
--------------------------------------
Read the current script, bump SCRIPT_VERSION, add a CHANGE comment.

Change the k3s binary check:

- Do not look for a binary inside the repository tree.
- If $MANUAL_FETCH_DIR/k3s/k3s exists, verify its SHA-256 against
  versions.lock and report it as a manually staged binary.
- Otherwise, if K3S_BINARY_URL is set, HEAD-probe the URL using the
  OS trust store and a bounded timeout (10s). Report the HTTP status
  and Content-Length if returned; do not download the body.
- If K3S_BINARY_URL is empty, report step_fail with fix-hint: "set
  K3S_BINARY_URL in lab-vm.conf to the Artifactory generic-file URL
  for the pinned k3s binary — ask your Artifactory administrator".
- Do not probe GitHub.
- Do not check for or mention the k3s airgap image tarball.
- Preserve the read-only behavior, report-block protocol, --selftest,
  and the existing content and CA checks.

Task 4 — update scripts/45-k3s-install.sh
----------------------------------------
Read the current script, bump SCRIPT_VERSION, add a CHANGE comment.

Fetch and install the k3s binary with this precedence:

1. If $MANUAL_FETCH_DIR/k3s/k3s exists, use it after verifying
   SHA-256 against versions.lock.
2. Otherwise, require K3S_BINARY_URL to be non-empty. Download to a
   temporary file with TLS validation and a bounded timeout; verify
   SHA-256 before installing. On mismatch or fetch failure: do not
   install; report URL (no credentials), HTTP/error details, expected
   and actual SHA, and fix-hint pointing at K3S_BINARY_URL and
   MANUAL-FETCH.md Section B.

Do not fetch the k3s binary from GitHub on the learner VM.

Remove all references to the airgap images tarball. Do not check for
it, do not copy it, do not mention it in comments or diagnostics.

Configure k3s registries.yaml (mirrors + CA) before the first start
so system images come from Artifactory. Verify a healthy k3s boot
with system pods Ready and system images present in the k3s store.
Do not claim Artifactory-based k3s pulls have been tested on the
learner network.

On bootstrap failure include: K3S_BINARY_URL (redacted of any
credentials), DNS and TLS diagnostics, k3s journal, registries.yaml
content, and failed image references.

Task 5 — update scripts/62-k3s-images.sh
----------------------------------------
Use `k3s crictl pull <original-reference>` for external Kubernetes
images (CRI is mirror-aware). Use `podman save` + `k3s ctr -n k8s.io
images import` only for locally built Podman images.

Remove any reference to a pre-staged image bundle as a required
input. If an optional local bundle path still exists, keep it only
as an informational fallback and do not require it. On failure,
print reference, endpoint, k3s version, `k3s crictl images`, and
journal excerpts.

Task 6 — rewrite MANUAL-FETCH.md and manual-fetch.json
-----------------------------------------------------
Reframe from "what to stage before transfer" to "what the VM fetches
at runtime and how to recover on-failure."

New structure:

Section A — In repository (already present)
  Every small vendored file that travels with the repo: workshop
  repos, docs mirrors, runtime-download archives, k3s install.sh,
  k3s-selinux RPM, vendored app_pod.yaml, reveal.js-menu, CA on the
  base image. Purpose: state explicitly that nothing here needs
  action.

Section B — Fetched at provisioning time on the VM
  The k3s binary. Runtime source: K3S_BINARY_URL (Artifactory
  generic-file URL). Fallback if the fetch fails: download the
  pinned file on the VM from the same Artifactory URL (or from any
  machine that can reach the same source), place it at
  $MANUAL_FETCH_DIR/k3s/k3s, verify SHA-256 against versions.lock,
  rerun script 45. Document the exact commands to do this on the VM.

Section C — Container images, fetched at provisioning time
  Pulled from $DOCKER_REGISTRY by scripts 60 and 62. Fallback: if
  Artifactory is unreachable, contact the Artifactory administrator
  — do not attempt a public-internet fallback. If a specific image
  is not available via the mirror, list the reference, endpoint, and
  the diagnostics to capture before escalating.

Drop every reference to: payload archives, single ZIPs, sidecars,
airgap image tarballs, image bundle generation, or transferring
anything beyond the repository.

Regenerate manual-fetch.json to match. Entries now describe runtime
fetches and their recovery, not pre-transfer staging.

Task 7 — rewrite README-FIRST.md
--------------------------------
The primary workflow is:

1. Commit and push repo changes on the connected machine.
2. Bring the repo onto the airgapped network (however that is done:
   internal mirror, approved file transfer of the repository, etc.).
3. On the learner VM, clone or copy the repo to a working directory.
4. Edit learner-vm/lab-vm.conf and set K3S_BINARY_URL to the
   Artifactory generic-file URL for the pinned k3s binary.
5. From learner-vm/, run `sudo bash scripts/00-diagnose.sh`.
6. Transcribe the complete REPORT block into
   feedback/airgap-run-001.md and wait for review.
7. After review, run scripts 10 through 80 in numeric order,
   transcribing each report block.
8. When 80-verify-offline passes both parts, shut down cleanly and
   snapshot the VM.

State plainly: nothing besides the repository is transferred; all
runtime dependencies come from Artifactory; the operator sets one
variable on the VM before provisioning.

Remove the packager, payload archive, checksum sidecar, airgap
tarball, and image bundle sections.

Task 8 — consistency audit
--------------------------
Grep the whole repository (excluding .git/ and dist/) for stale
references and update them:

  "payload archive", "o11y-lab-vm-payload", "payload-manifest",
  "MANUAL-FETCH-payload", "single ZIP", "single-ZIP",
  "package-vm-transfer", "make-image-bundles",
  "k3s-airgap-images", "airgap tarball", "content/vendor/payload",
  "content/vendor/k3s/k3s" (as a required in-repo path),
  "docker-compose-v2", "content/bin"

Expected outcomes:
- superseded by the repo-only model: rewrite;
- historical prompt files under .github/prompts/ or similar: leave
  unchanged unless they are operator-facing;
- obscura under feedback/: leave unchanged (historical record).

Validation — connected machine only
-----------------------------------
Run:
- bash -n and ShellCheck on all changed scripts;
- pre-commit run --all-files;
- scripts/00-diagnose.sh --selftest;
- grep audit above, and report which matches remain and why.

Do not run provisioning scripts against the learner VM. Do not claim
Artifactory reachability, k3s installation, image pulls, or offline
operation have been verified there.

Acceptance
----------
1. Paste the updated lab-vm.conf in full.
2. Paste MANUAL-FETCH.md and README-FIRST.md in full.
3. Paste the grep audit result, listing every remaining match and
   whether it is intentional.
4. Paste bash syntax, ShellCheck, pre-commit, and --selftest results.
5. State explicitly: the packager is retired (or moved to
   scripts/dev/retired/), the airgap tarball is dropped, the repo is
   the only transfer artifact.
6. Confirm the learner VM was not accessed and no provisioning
   script was executed against it.
7. Leave all changes uncommitted and unstaged.
